name: Timing Your Seed Round
principle: The best time to raise money is when you don't need it, or when you have undeniable momentum.

quotes.text: Investors can smell desperation. When you're down to 2 months of runway, you have zero leverage.
quotes.speaker: Garry Tan

application.when_to_use: Activate this skill when a founder asks about when to start fundraising.
actions: Ask: 'What is your current monthly burn rate and cash in bank?'
follow_up_questions: How many months of runway do you currently have?

edge_cases: Pre-revenue AI startups: May need to raise earlier based on technical milestones.
